scope: Remaining DOG FENCES/GATES source gap: is there a current (2026) primary photo with a caption, alt text or municipal metadata that shows the actual Biidaasige dog-area fence/gate, and does any photo carry GPS or municipal metadata giving an exact source position?
method: Bounded primary-source photo pass (~8 min). Fetched and inspected the City Recreation page, City main park page, Waterfront Toronto 2026 west-expansion news, Waterfront Toronto Biidaasige project page, and the MVVA Port Lands project page. Extracted every image URL, caption and alt text; parsed EXIF/XMP for date and GPS. Cached a handful of 2026 candidates privately for the captain. No pixels interpreted; no coordinates invented.
ownership: NEW files only: docs/biidaasige-dog-fence-photos.md and this fixture. Private cache under $WATERFRONT_RESEARCH/biidaasige/dog-fence-photos/ (index.json). No meshes/shared files/runtime/GPU/browser/commits/bead-close. Captain integrates and personally views images.

conclusion.answer: No captioned primary photo of the Biidaasige dog fence/gate was found in this bounded pass. The primary City and Waterfront Toronto pages and the MVVA project page carry no caption or alt text identifying a dog fence or gate. Several 2026 photos exist but are uncaptioned. One 2026 drone photo carries GPS but is a wide aerial ~500 m from the west dog area and is AI-retouched.
conclusion.status: honest bounded negative; 2026 candidates cached for captain pixel review
conclusion.reasoning: City recreation page, City park page, WT 2026 news, WT project page and MVVA project page were checked. The only dog reference is WT project-page prose ('Two off-leash dog areas') with no photo. MVVA's 19-image gallery has no captions/alt text and no dog/fence mention. The one GPS-bearing 2026 image is a drone aerial with Firefly generative edits, ~500 m from the west dog-area centroid.
